observations.observation: Overall layout: the original uses no flex or grid (display_flex 0, display_grid 0) and looks only partly styled, with content and images pushed flush left at x=0. The AI-built page centres its content in a 1080px column (x=180–1260) inside the 1440px viewport, using 15 grid and 22 flex containers.

A pale yellow announcement bar runs across the very top. It holds the condensed uppercase label 'FUN & FRESH HOME GOODIES' and a peach block with a script 'visit the shop' link. The AI-built page has no top announcement bar.

tags.original_value: pale yellow bar with shop link

observations.observation: Logo: the original centres a large script-and-serif wordmark, 'never skip brunch by cara newhart', in the header. The AI-built page puts a small 112x56 stamp-style raster logo at the left, with descriptive alt text.

Navigation: the original splits six nav items, three on each side of the centred logo. Each item has a tiny orange script kicker above a letterspaced uppercase label, and some have dropdown carets. The AI-built page has a plain six-link text nav at the right of a translucent cream header with backdrop blur, no visible dropdowns, and a hidden 'Menu' button.
Dropdown caret icons render as empty tofu squares because the icon font did not load.

Hero: the original uses a full-bleed 1440x572 interior photo with a white card overlapping its lower part. The AI-built page uses a two-column hero on a peach-to-pink gradient, with text on the left and a tall portrait photo on the right cropped into an arch with a soft shadow.

Newsletter signup: the original puts a three-field form (First Name, Last Name, E-Mail Address) in the hero card, with hairline inputs and a small square dark 'GO' button, and adds closing 'join the newsletter.' blocks. The AI-built page has a centred newsletter section on a blush background near the bottom, with a single pill email input, a black 'Subscribe' pill and a visually hidden label.

Calls to action: the original styles its primary CTA as plain orange text ('about + learn more') with a transparent background, 0 radius and 0 padding, and has 0 buttons. Its main signup CTA is a PNG image with a hand-drawn arrow. The AI-built page uses live pill buttons: a solid near-black and an outlined pill in the hero, black pills with white bold text elsewhere, and short action labels such as 'Dive in' and 'Get in touch'.

An 'As seen in' press band shows HouseBeautiful, NBC News, Apple Podcasts, Apartment Therapy and others as one raster image with empty alt, on a torn-paper peach strip. The AI-built page has no press-logo band.

h1: the original's h1 is the wordmark 'NEVER SKIP BRUNCH' in Playfair at 50px, weight 400, centred, and appears hidden behind the logo. The AI-built page's h1 is a visible tagline, 'A beautifully lived-in life starts here.', in 67.2px bold Playfair Display, left-aligned, with 'lived-in' in an italic orange-brown accent.

Display headings: the original sets section headings in a very large geometric sans (Poppins, about 100–120px) with two-tone colour splits, such as pale yellow 'projects' with dark '& tips' and orange caps 'MAKE SPACE' over dark 'podcast'. The AI-built page uses bold Playfair Display serif h2s at 41.6px and smaller serif h3s at about 24px.

Font families: the original mixes Poppins (403 elements), Montserrat, Trirong, the script Moontime and Playfair. The AI-built page uses three families: Inter (213), Playfair Display (24) and the script Caveat (8).
Body text: the original is 16px on a 32px line-height (2.0). The AI-built page is 17px on a 28.05px line-height.

Small lowercase handwritten script labels (eyebrows such as 'the blog') sit above larger section headings as an accent layer. The original uses Moontime for these; the AI-built page uses Caveat in orange-brown or mustard.
Body and nav text is set in wide-tracked, letterspaced sans, with uppercase nav labels such as 'P R O J E C T S' and loosely spaced paragraphs.

Palette: both pages are warm, built on orange and peach. The original has a white body background, near-black text rgb(34,34,34) and a golden orange rgb(243,179,79) accent on 136 elements. The AI-built page has a cream body background rgb(255,250,245), warm near-black text rgb(27,22,19), a burnt-orange text accent rgb(184,90,18), and mustard rgb(232,181,32) and orange rgb(242,153,74) fills.

tags.generated_value: burnt orange and mustard on cream

observations.observation: Section backgrounds: the original is mostly white, with a cream surface, occasional peach strips, a yellow damask podcast area and a dark footer. The AI-built page alternates full-width bands of cream, peach gradient, a dark near-black 'meet Cara' band (17 elements on rgb(27,22,19)), light peach and blush, ending in a dark footer.

About section: the original places a 1081x1081 headshot of the host holding a nail gun flush left, with empty space to its right and empty alt. The AI-built page uses a dark two-column band, with an italic serif pull-quote and a mustard left border on one side, and an eyebrow, a white h2, body text and a mustard pill on the other.

Blog intro: the original lays 'visit the blog' and 'if you . . .' copy directly over a busy photo with no overlay or container. The AI-built page uses two peach audience callout boxes ('Experienced DIYers', 'Newcomers') in a left column, beside a 'Latest in DIY' column.

Blog post feed: the original stacks three article blocks, each with a 1000x1556 portrait photo at natural size, flush left and watermarked (one lazy-loaded at 0x0). The AI-built page lists three full-width bordered anchor cards with a kicker, an h3 and an arrow SVG, and no thumbnails.
Post category labels: the original puts small orange 'DIY' text on a peach category bar. The AI-built page uses small uppercase orange kicker text, such as 'DIY · PART 02'.

Post titles: the original sets them as lowercase, letterspaced orange serif h2s at weight 400, with em dashes, one truncated mid-word ('on a budg…'). The AI-built page uses sentence-case serif h3s with colons and no em dashes.
An archive line in muted brown-gray reads 'The archive spans 60 pages: 2, 3 … 60. More DIY posts →', with underlined bold number links.

Podcast section: the original uses a pale yellow damask-pattern background, with a phone-on-books photo cropped at the right edge. The AI-built page uses a two-column layout, with a 539x276 rounded, shadowed cover image on the left and text with underlined links and a black pill on the right.

YouTube promo: the original uses a full-width raster banner image (YT-SUBSCRIBE png, rendered 1440x173). The AI-built page builds a rounded CSS banner with a diagonal mustard-to-orange gradient, a serif heading and a black 'Watch on YouTube' pill.

Instagram feed: the original uses placeholder.png images that do not render, with very long caption alt text and about 1300px blank gaps between short orange caption lines. The AI-built page shows a 4x2 grid of white bordered, rounded text-only tiles, each with a caption and an orange 'VIEW POST' label.
A giant orange Instagram glyph near the bottom of the page is scaled to roughly the full 1440px viewport width.
Instagram follow prompt: the original shows 'Follow on Instagram' highlighted on a peach strip above the footer. The AI-built page uses an outlined 'Follow @neverskipbrunch' pill below the grid.

Contact and social block: the original has 'let’s connect' and 'looking for something?' heading blocks (h4) for connect and search. The AI-built page pairs a rounded armchair photo with a 'Get in touch' pill and five circular 44px black SVG social icon links.

Footer: both are dark. The original is a thin rgb(51,51,51) band with low-contrast copyright text and an orange 'by Cara Newhart' credit. The AI-built page has three serif-h4 link columns (Explore, Work together, More), a hairline divider, an affiliate disclosure and a copyright line.

A 'Pick your project' section shows four equal white cards in a grid. Each has a coloured top bar, a serif h3, a list of links with dotted dividers and a pill CTA; the shop card's CTA is mustard instead of black.
Heading and text blocks sit in a left-aligned column about half the page width (515–640px). The newsletter section is the one centred exception.

Corner radii: the original is almost entirely square (539 elements at 0, 1 in the 8–15px bucket, 1 pill). The AI-built page uses pills (19) and large radii of 16px or more (21) on buttons, inputs, cards and images.

Effects: the original has 0 gradients, no blur, 1 transition, 1 transform and 3 box-shadows. The AI-built page has 2 gradients, 1 backdrop blur, 33 transitions, 0 transforms and 2 box-shadows. Neither page has animations.

Link styling: the original uses plain orange text links. The AI-built page varies by context: plain nav links, dotted separators in cards, solid underlines with a peach accent in the podcast section, and light gray links on the dark footer.

Images: the original has 17 large, often natural-size photos and raster graphics. The AI-built page has 4 images with context-specific crops (an arch, and rounded rectangles with or without a shadow), and uses colour blocks and type elsewhere.
Page length and density: the original is 29,448px tall with 540 words, so large images and blank areas dominate. The AI-built page is 5,118px tall with 560 words.

Heading outline: both pages have a single h1. The original's outline is flat and irregular, with 29 h3s used mostly for menu labels (some empty or decorative dots) and only 3 h2s. The AI-built page follows h1, then h2 sections with h3 children, then h4 in the footer.
Uppercase menu and mega-menu labels with trailing periods, such as 'BROWSE HOME PROJECTS.' and 'SUBSCRIBE.', are marked up as h3 headings.

Landmarks: the original has 4 headers, 2 navs, 1 main, 22 sections and 4 footers. The AI-built page has 1 header, 1 nav, 1 main, 8 sections and 1 footer. Both have 4 articles and no figure, blockquote or aside.

Code footprint: the original is a WordPress/Genesis-style plugin stack, with 74 scripts, 19 style tags, 21 noscripts, 699 class uses (231 unique) and 29 inline style attributes. The AI-built page has 1 script, 1 stylesheet, 73 class uses (32 unique) and 5 inline styles. Both have low Tailwind-like class fractions (0.3% and 1.4%).

Accessibility attributes: the original has many empty-alt images, 1 missing alt and 32 aria attributes. The AI-built page gives all 4 images descriptive alt text (0 missing) and has 12 aria attributes; its social icon links contain only SVGs, with no visible text.
A 500x23 transparent spacer image is used to hold layout space.

Metadata: the original has a keyword-led title, lang en-US, Open Graph and Twitter tags, and 1 JSON-LD block. The AI-built page has the title 'Never Skip Brunch | Empowering women to DIY big', lang en, only charset, viewport and description metas, and no JSON-LD.

Copy tone: both are warm, first-person and brunch-themed. The original uses 4 emoji, 3 exclamations and 6 em dashes, with lowercase headings ending in periods or ellipses ('if you . . .', 'pick one:'). The AI-built page uses 0 emoji, 0 exclamations and 0 em dashes, with sentence-case headings and phrases like 'DIY queen' and 'what's on the menu'.
